Officer's narrative
On the reported date, I responded to a sideswipe collision on a roadway in League City, Texas. Driver 1 told me they
were changing lanes when the vehicle on their right, operated by Driver 2, moved into the same space and made
contact aolng the driver's side. Driver 2 gave a statement that matched this account in its sequence and location. Two
independent witnesses at the scene described the same lane change and impact, and photographs taken at the
scene show damage to the driver's side panels that is consistent with a glancing strike of this kind. No prior damage
to Driver 1's vehicle was noted by anyone present or in my review. Passenger was seated in the vehicle at the time,
and both the witnesses and I observed Passenger in the vehicle after the collision. Driver 1 reported pain in the
shoulder, which EMS personnel assessed at the scene and which fits the direction and force of the impact. Driver 1 is
listed as an insured driver on the policy for the vehicle involved. Both vehicles were drivable from the scene, and no
citations were issued.
